name: HelperText
description: Supporting hint or error text rendered under a form field, in caption type.

props.name: intent
props.description: neutral = subtle hint color, error = utility error color.

props.name: id
props.description: id so the paired control can reference this text via aria-describedby.

notes: Give HelperText an id and reference it from the paired control with aria-describedby.
For error intent, the paired control should also set aria-invalid='true'; color alone must not be the only error signal (WCAG 1.4.1).
